purpose: Expose actual cached native thruster vectors and aerodynamic application-point/split observations for aircraft force diagnostics.

source.scope: Read-only cached force getters/ties; consistent aero observer cache initialization; focused native and real-WASM regressions; wrapper version metadata. No native force allocation or integration change.

observations.thruster: propulsion/engine[n]/body-force-x/y/z-lbs, resolved cached body force in pounds; reads do not call transform/moment calculation.
observations.aerodynamics: aero/rp-body-x/y/z-ft relative to CG, including native RP shift; forces/fbx/y/z-aero-rp-lbs and -aero-cg-lbs preserve apply_at_cg distinction.
observations.net: Existing native applied-total plus native weight may be shown as an explicitly labeled exact vector sum. Applied total includes native friction/contact and excludes gravity.

commands: node --test --test-concurrency=5 test/*.test.mjs (frozen SDK workspace and resolved native fixtures)
sdkBuildValidation.scope: One clean frozen-source build, locked toolchain; 5 compile jobs and 5 Node test workers.

installedRegressions.scope: Native aircraft force reader/overlay and actual C172/F35 aggregate/split/anchor observations; no aircraft handling qualification.

fullApplicationCi.status: superseded by necessary fork11 stopped-thrust repair before full app acceptance

browserLoadedAssets.status: not attempted for fork10 at record creation

limitations: No force reconstruction from scalar thrust/angles occurs in the observer.
Native cached vectors show the last evaluated state, not a future command.
No upstream submission/push or package publication.
F35 aircraft allocation/handling qualification is separate.
A separate existing off-turbine zero-time Trim thrust defect was discovered downstream after this immutable build; recorded separately for a following correction.
